items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The FFmpeg port in yuv2rgb.zig is mostly readable and notes the RGB32/BGR32 aliasing. But names are terse (v0..v3, out0, cb, yb, crv, cbu), and swizzle kernels use raw @shuffle masks like {2,1,0,6,5,4,...,-3,-2,-1,-7} with no comment.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Kernels are split by family (input/output/unscaled/filter/scale/yuv2rgb.zig). But unscaled.zig repeats near-identical loops per format pair (RGBA->BGR24 vs BGRA->RGB24), and the diff commits .zig-cache/ (862-line hash file) and the zig-out .so build output.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Allocation failures propagate via `try allocator.alloc` and deinit frees yuvTable. Magic constants (326/384, 0x8000, 1<<13) are uncommented, and pointer math uses @ptrFromInt/@bitCast casts instead of checked slices.

items.name: Geometry, stride and tail handling
items.name_zh: 几何尺寸、步长与尾部处理
items.evidence: Visible SIMD swizzles have scalar tails (`while (x < width) : (x += 1)`). All 58 contract cases pass, including up/down scaling. Large-stride handling and NULL returns for unsupported combinations aren't visible in the diff, so they're unverified.

items.name: ABI and build-target conformance
items.name_zh: ABI 与构建目标符合要求
items.evidence: nm -D lists only swscale_create, swscale_process and swscale_destroy as T symbols. Built via the scaffold's build.zig with the x86-64-v3 target. Tables are precomputed in create (Yuv2RgbTables.init). No threads.
